Name: Secret Woods Hedge Maze CP
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]

This mod modifies the Secret Forest to add a new 55x55 tile area containing a procedural-generated hedge maze using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14138]Hedge Maze Framework[/url] mod. Adds one for Stardew Valley Expanded as well.

The maze is a secret, so you'll have to explore the secret forest to find it.

The maze is completely remade every day.

By default tiles in the maze are hidden until a farmer walks through them (can be turned off in the config).

The maze contains various highly customizable features, as outlined below.


[size=4][b]Treasure[/b][/size]

If you install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7739]Advanced Loot Framework[/url], the maze will spawn up to three random-value treasure chests at random dead-end tiles each day.


[size=4][b]Forage[/b][/size]

The maze spawns the same sort of forage items as are found in the rest of the secret forest.


[size=4][b]Monsters[/b][/size]

The maze spawns a random number of the following monsters:

[list]
[*]slimes (random color and difficulty)[/*]
[*]bats (random color and difficulty)[/*]
[*]serpents[/*]
[*]shadow brutes[/*]
[*]shadow shamans[/*]
[*]skeletons[/*]
[*]squid kids[/*]
[*]dust sprites[/*]
[/list]

[b][size=5][size=4]Fairies[/size][/size]
[/b]
The maze spawns a random number of health and stamina replenishing fairies that disappear when clicked on.


[size=5][b][size=4]Dwarf[/size]
[/b][/size]
The maze spawns a dwarven merchant (you must speak dwarven to access the shop).


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
